answers.core: I feel like people who come from strongly typed programming languages need to swallow this hard pill, and speaking from my experience, I feel a bit uncomfortable that I cannot specify what Types/behaviour I want for my variables, and also the hassle of setting everything by hand, and not getting it automatically also annoys me a bit.
answers.workaround: Autocompletion, and keys/values having the desired type when created, without setting their values beforehand, would need a bunch of Dictionary specific code, which can easily multiply the lines of code in a project.
